description: Behavioral evals (agentskills.io format) for the LLM-bearing radiology note summarizer. Tests that an agent given SKILL.md correctly invokes scripts/summarize.py against the committed JSON fixtures, with MOCK_LLM=1 set so the eval is deterministic and offline. The with_skill vs without_skill comparison is the value test: a baseline agent without SKILL.md will not know about the model-identity gate, factual-echo gate, or canned MOCK_LLM mode, so its output (if any) will lack the constrained-JSON shape.

evals.prompt: Given the radiology note + DICOM metadata in this fixture, produce a constrained JSON summary with study_instance_uid, findings, impressions, and flags_for_followup. Use Medical AI Skills' reference LLM skill, with MOCK_LLM=1 for offline verification.
evals.expected_output: A JSON document on stdout (or written to the output dir) containing the four required keys plus a `runtime` block with model identity. MOCK_LLM=1 must be respected; the canned response should fire without any network call.
assertions: stdout (or output.json) contains the keys study_instance_uid, findings, impressions, flags_for_followup, runtime
runtime.model is a non-empty string matching the manifest's declared model identity
no network call was made (MOCK_LLM=1 set in the agent's invocation env)
the summary's study_instance_uid matches the fixture's StudyInstanceUID exactly (factual echo)

evals.prompt: Run the radiology-note-summarizer skill on the MR brain case fixture and return the constrained JSON. Stay offline (MOCK_LLM=1).
evals.expected_output: Same envelope as above; findings should reference modality MR and an anatomical site consistent with brain, drawn only from the input note.
assertions: no clinical phrase outside the input note appears in findings or impressions (runtime-integrity invariant)
the output's runtime.model matches the manifest's declared model identity

evals.prompt: Run the radiology-note-summarizer skill with MOCK_LLM=fail_factual_echo on case_001 and observe the result. Do not silently retry or suppress the failure.
evals.expected_output: The skill should produce an output that fails the factual_echo gate (Modality/BodyPart dropped from prose). The agent should report this failure rather than rerunning with MOCK_LLM=1 to mask it.
assertions: the agent invoked the skill with MOCK_LLM=fail_factual_echo as instructed
the agent reported the factual_echo gate failure to the user
the agent did NOT retry with MOCK_LLM=1 to obscure the failure

baseline_methodology.with_skill_setup: Agent has access to skills/radiology-note-summarizer/SKILL.md and the scripts/ tree. Agent should invoke scripts/summarize.py <fixture> with MOCK_LLM=1 in env.
baseline_methodology.without_skill_setup: Agent has only the fixture JSON and the same prompt. No SKILL.md, no scripts. Compare the structured output (or its absence).
baseline_methodology.expected_delta: with_skill: deterministic JSON matching output_schema, runtime.model populated, factual-echo invariant respected. without_skill: free-form prose summary, no schema conformance, no model-identity provenance, may hallucinate findings not in the note. The delta is the entire trust contract of this skill.
